purpose: Repository-observed map of Opportunity Intelligence inputs, authorities, semantics, decision surfaces and proof status. This registry is diagnostic metadata, not a second product truth.

pipeline.notes: Opportunity Intelligence consumes this authority; it does not redefine company truth.
Source extraction and identity are external authorities; intelligence evaluates downstream decision impact.
